observations: Predicted east-west error would exceed north-south error on Coronelli's 1688 Great Lakes map.
Viewed four positional overlays: Coronelli59/363 km N-S/E-W, Popple62/224, Mitchell48/46, Melish24/41.
The 11-map bar chart reported east-west worse on nine of eleven, visibly preserving exceptions rather than a universal claim.
Reveal matched the observed numbers and explained latitude versus longitude measurement; it noted the 39 points per map were read by hand.
At 1280×720 the lower numerical summary was partially hidden inside the fixed visualization area, though AX and the reveal exposed the values.
